description:
The existing timber single-glazed windows are proposed to be retained in situ and repaired as necessary. The scope of works will include the careful refurbishment of the existing window frames and sashes, overhaul or replacement of ironmongery and associated operational components where required, together with any localised repairs to the surrounding masonry and window reveals arising from the works. 

Door Replacements
No. 1/1a, 2 and 3 Main entrance doors ground floor - proposed doors are Timber Apex/Tudor arched door with two single glazed panes over a solid tongue and groove panel 
No. 1/1a, 2 and 3 Rear exit doors ground floor  - Timber with a single glazed pane over a solid tongue and groove panel 

Roof Replacement - Replacement with new natural Welsh slate tile across all three properties

External Decorations - The works will comprise localised repairs to existing external building fabric where required prior to redecoration, including repairs to timber joinery, rainwater goods, masonry and other external architectural features where deterioration has occurred. All previously painted surfaces will be prepared and redecorated on a like-for-like basis using appropriate breathable paint systems and colours to match the existing appearance. Defective sealants and minor areas of deteriorated pointing will be repaired where necessary, together with localised making good associated with the proposed works.
